{{Top|leg}}
'''Aquascouts''' were shiny-hulled aquatic vehicles that were used for exploration on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Velusia/Legends|Velusia]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

{{RPGseed}}
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], an aquascout disappeared while surveying an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] trench on Velusia. A group of adventurers were sent to look for the lost aquascout but were forced to contend with a gigantic bramblefish that was attracted by the shine of the adventurers' own aquascout.<ref name="CatCW" />
{{Endgame}}
